mapper.select: select distinct m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_type, m.menu_name, m.route_path, m.route_name, m.component, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.keep_alive, m.perms, m.status, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 1 order by m.sort asc, m.id asc
